label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
Some good news first: Priya Bhatia is joining the practice on Monday 16 November. Priya is a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) and has spent the last nine years working for a consultancy in Coventry. I’m genuinely delighted to have her coming on board. If she visits your home or site over the coming weeks, please do say hello and make her feel welcome.

Her arrival also means I can do something properly about my turnaround times. In September and October, beam calculations and drawings were taking 5–6 weeks. That was too long, and I’m sorry. The target now is **10 working days**.

I won’t dress up what happened. Several clients waited far longer than they should have. A few were understandably unhappy, and one left a sharp review; given the delays, I can understand why. One couple in Harborne had their builder waiting and the steel already ordered. We got their calculations to them within three days, but only after they had chased twice. They shouldn’t have needed to.

The slow weeks were my fault: I said yes to too much work and tried to do it all myself. I was doing site visits during the day and calculations until midnight. My wife started calling the office “the other house”, which was probably a polite way of making a point.

If your job is currently with me, please know that it is moving. You’re welcome to message me directly for an update.

There is also a change to first site visits. The free visit has been helpful, but around a third of those visits have not turned into a job, and I need to protect time for live projects.

**First site visits taking place on or after 1 January 2027 will cost £95.** If you go ahead with me, that £95 will be deducted from your fee.

Importantly, **any visit already booked when this post is published remains free**, whatever date it is taking place, including visits after 1 January.

Priya joining is a real step forward, not a way of pretending the last two months didn’t happen. Thank you to everyone who has been patient, and to those who told me plainly when I’d fallen short. I’m looking forward to giving you a much quicker, better service.
